SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(tax_amount), 2), 0) AS total_tax_paid
FROM transactions
WHERE user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
LIMIT 100;

SELECT category, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0), 2) AS total_spent
FROM transactions
WHERE user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT vendor_name, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0), 2) AS total_spent
FROM transactions
WHERE user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
GROUP BY vendor_name
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT vendor_name) AS vendor_count
FROM transactions
WHERE user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
LIMIT 100;

SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2), 0) AS average_electricity_bill
FROM transactions
WHERE user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
  AND LOWER(category) = 'utilities'
  AND LOWER(vendor_name) LIKE '%electric%';

SELECT
    payment_method,
    ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(total_amount), 0), 2) AS average_amount
FROM transactions
WHERE user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
GROUP BY payment_method
LIMIT 100;

SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2), 0) AS total_spent
FROM transactions
WHERE user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
LIMIT 100;
SELECT MAX(total_amount) AS largest_purchase FROM transactions WHERE user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362';

SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2), 0) AS total_spent
FROM transactions
WHERE user_id = '3f0a1212-d35d-5ebe-96ae-3bce34b8a85f'
  AND LOWER(category) = 'transport'
  AND (LOWER(vendor_name) LIKE '%fuel%' OR LOWER(vendor_name) LIKE '%gas%' OR LOWER(vendor_name) LIKE '%petrol%' OR LOWER(vendor_name) LIKE '%shell%' OR LOWER(vendor_name) LIKE '%bp%' OR LOWER(vendor_name) LIKE '%exxon%' OR LOWER(vendor_name) LIKE '%chevron%' OR LOWER(vendor_name) LIKE '%mobil%' OR LOWER(vendor_name) LIKE '%texaco%')
LIMIT 100;

SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2), 0) AS total_paid
FROM transactions
WHERE user_id = '3f0a1212-d35d-5ebe-96ae-3bce34b8a85f'
  AND LOWER(vendor_name) LIKE '%yoga%'
  AND LOWER(category) = 'healthcare'
LIMIT 100;

SELECT
    category,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0), 2) AS total_spent
FROM transactions
WHERE user_id = '3f0a1212-d35d-5ebe-96ae-3bce34b8a85f'
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 100;

```sql
    id,
    user_id,
    date,
    total_amount,
    tax_amount,
    vendor_name,
    invoice_number,
    category,
    payment_method,
    address,
    created_at
FROM transactions
WHERE user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
```

SELECT
    t.id,
    t.date,
    t.vendor_name,
    t.category,
    t.total_amount,
    t.tax_amount,
    t.invoice_number,
    t.payment_method
FROM transactions t
WHERE t.user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
  AND LOWER(t.payment_method) = 'cash'
ORDER BY t.date DESC
LIMIT 100;

```sql
FROM transactions
WHERE user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
  AND LOWER(payment_method) = 'upi'
ORDER BY vendor_name
LIMIT 100;
```

```sql
SELECT 
```
```sql
    id,
    date,
    total_amount,
    tax_amount,
    vendor_name,
    invoice_number,
    category,
    payment_method,
    address,
    created_at
FROM transactions
WHERE user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
  AND (tax_amount IS NULL OR tax_amount = 0)

LIMIT 100;
```

SELECT
    id,
    date,
    vendor_name,
    total_amount,
    category,
    payment_method
FROM transactions
WHERE user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
  AND LOWER(category) = 'entertainment'
ORDER BY date DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT date, vendor_name, total_amount, category, payment_method
FROM transactions
WHERE user_id = '3f0a1212-d35d-5ebe-96ae-3bce34b8a85f'
  AND LOWER(vendor_name) LIKE '%petpals clinic%'
ORDER BY date DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT
    t.id,
    t.date,
    t.vendor_name,
    t.invoice_number,
    t.total_amount,
    t.tax_amount,
    t.payment_method,
    t.address
FROM transactions t
WHERE t.user_id = '3f0a1212-d35d-5ebe-96ae-3bce34b8a85f'
  AND LOWER(t.category) = 'shopping'
  AND t.total_amount > 3000
ORDER BY t.date DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2), 0) AS total_spent
FROM transactions
WHERE user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
  AND date >= date('2026-06-30', 'start of month', '-1 month')
  AND date < date('2026-06-30', 'start of month')
LIMIT 100;

```sql
SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', date) AS month,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0), 2) AS total_spent
FROM transactions
WHERE user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
  AND strftime('%Y', date) = '2026'
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', date)
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 100;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    strftime('%Y-%m', date) AS month,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0), 2) AS total_spent
FROM transactions
WHERE user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', date)
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2), 0) AS total_spent
FROM transactions
WHERE user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', date) = '2025-12'
LIMIT 100;
```

```sql
SELECT MAX(date) AS most_recent_date
FROM transactions
WHERE user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362';
```

SELECT 
    COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2), 0) AS total_spent
FROM transactions
WHERE user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
  AND date >= '2026-01-01'
  AND date <= '2026-03-31'
LIMIT 100;

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM transactions
WHERE user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', date) = '2026-06'
LIMIT 100;
```

SELECT MIN(date) AS first_shop_date
FROM transactions
WHERE user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
  AND LOWER(vendor_name) = 'urbanwear apparel'
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    ti.item_name,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(ti.total_price), 0), 2) AS total_spent
FROM transaction_items ti
JOIN transactions t ON ti.transaction_id = t.id
WHERE t.user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
GROUP BY ti.item_name
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 1;

```sql
SELECT ti.item_name, ti.quantity, ti.unit_price, ti.total_price
FROM transaction_items ti
JOIN transactions t ON ti.transaction_id = t.id
WHERE t.user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
  AND LOWER(t.vendor_name) LIKE '%techhub electronics%'
LIMIT 100;
```

SELECT t.id, t.date, t.vendor_name, t.total_amount, COUNT(ti.id) AS item_count
FROM transactions t
JOIN transaction_items ti ON t.id = ti.transaction_id
WHERE t.user_id = '3f0a1212-d35d-5ebe-96ae-3bce34b8a85f'
GROUP BY t.id, t.date, t.vendor_name, t.total_amount
HAVING COUNT(ti.id) > 2
ORDER BY t.date DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(payment_method) LIKE '%bank%' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS bank_balance
FROM transactions
WHERE user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
LIMIT 100;

SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2), 0) AS total_interest_paid
FROM transactions
WHERE user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
  AND LOWER(vendor_name) LIKE '%interest%'
  AND LOWER(category) = 'other';

SELECT id, date, total_amount, tax_amount, vendor_name, invoice_number, category, payment_method, address
FROM transactions
WHERE user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
  AND total_amount > 5000
ORDER BY date DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT DISTINCT vendor_name
FROM transactions
WHERE user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
  AND LOWER(payment_method) = 'upi'
ORDER BY vendor_name
LIMIT 100;

SELECT
    t.id,
    t.date,
    t.vendor_name,
    t.invoice_number,
    t.total_amount,
    t.tax_amount,
    t.payment_method,
    t.address,
    t.category
FROM transactions t
WHERE t.user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
  AND LOWER(t.category) = 'healthcare'
ORDER BY t.date DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT id, date, total_amount, tax_amount, vendor_name, invoice_number, category, payment_method, address
FROM transactions
WHERE user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
  AND (tax_amount IS NULL OR tax_amount = 0)
ORDER BY date DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT 
    strftime('%Y-%m', date) AS month,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0), 2) AS total_spent
FROM transactions
WHERE user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
  AND strftime('%Y', date) = '2026'
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', date)
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 100;

SELECT 
    strftime('%Y-%m', date) AS month,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0), 2) AS total_spent
FROM transactions
WHERE user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2), 0) AS total_spent
FROM transactions
WHERE user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', date) = '2025-12'
LIMIT 100;
SELECT date FROM transactions WHERE user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362' ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM transactions
WHERE user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', date) = '2026-06'
LIMIT 100;

SELECT ti.item_name, ti.quantity, ti.unit_price, ti.total_price, t.date, t.invoice_number
FROM transaction_items ti
JOIN transactions t ON ti.transaction_id = t.id
WHERE t.user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
  AND LOWER(t.vendor_name) = 'techhub electronics'
ORDER BY t.date DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) AS total_items
FROM transaction_items
WHERE transaction_id IN (
    SELECT id FROM transactions
    WHERE user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
)
LIMIT 100;

WITH milk_items AS (
    SELECT
        ti.quantity,
        ti.total_price,
        t.date
    FROM transaction_items ti
    JOIN transactions t ON ti.transaction_id = t.id
    WHERE t.user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
      AND LOWER(ti.item_name) LIKE '%milk%'
      AND ti.quantity > 0
)
SELECT
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(total_price) / SUM(quantity), 0), 2) AS avg_price_per_litre
FROM milk_items
LIMIT 100;

SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2), 0) AS current_balance
FROM transactions
WHERE user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
  AND date <= '2026-06-30';
SELECT 0 AS credit_score;
